name: io.github.arif-js/opensdr-mcp
title: OpenSDR
description: Open-source AI SDR: B2B prospecting, email enrichment, buying signals and safe outreach staging.

environmentVariables.name: APOLLO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Apollo API key for people/company search and enrichment (optional)

environmentVariables.name: HUNTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hunter API key for email finding and verification (optional)

environmentVariables.name: EXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Exa API key for buying signals and account research (optional)

environmentVariables.name: TAVILY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tavily API key, an alternative to Exa for signals and research (optional)

environmentVariables.name: INSTANTLY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Instantly API v2 key for draft campaigns and lead enrollment (optional)

environmentVariables.name: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: HubSpot private-app token for contact sync (optional)

environmentVariables.name: OPENSDR_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to disable every tool that writes to an external service

environmentVariables.name: OPENSDR_MAX_CREDITS_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Hard cap on estimated paid provider credits per tool call

environmentVariables.name: OPENSDR_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local data directory for lists, cache and suppression list (default ~/.opensdr)
